title: Cardinality after removing an inserted index
statement: Let $J$ and $P$ be subsets of the $n$ coordinate indices, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $f$ be a natural number. If $i\in J$, $i\notin P$, and $|J\setminus P|\le f+1$, then $|J\setminus(P\cup\{i\})|\le f$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ and $P$ are subsets of the $n$ coordinate indices
